headline: Abu Dhabi's IHC Doubles Net Profit in First Nine Months of 2026
summary: International Holding Company (IHC) reported that its net profit more than doubled in the first nine months of 2026, supported by continued real estate and construction activity.
why: Strong earnings growth from major sovereign-linked investment holding companies reflects economic momentum and asset deployment in the Gulf region.

impacts.name: International Holding Company
impacts.why: Substantial profit growth reinforces investor confidence in the conglomerate's portfolio.
